title: Packers president Ed Policy on Matt LaFleur extension: Analyze body of work over "emotional chaos"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Packers president Ed Policy on Matt LaFleur extension: Analyze body of work over "emotional chaos"
sources.description: Packers president Ed Policy made a big decision to kick off the team's offseason when he reached agreement with head coach Matt LaFleur on a contract extension.
